headline: Why do car wheels turn at different speeds?
hook_visual: Two attached wheels are shown at different rotation speeds while turning

evidence.claim: A differential allows driven wheels to rotate at different speeds

shots.visual_proof: Both wheels trace different radii through the corner
shots.mechanism_change: Outer wheel rotates measurably faster than inner wheel
shots.narration_en: On a turn, the outer wheel has a longer way to travel.

shots.visual_proof: The differential gears connect left and right axles
shots.mechanism_change: Planet gears visibly rotate as wheel speeds diverge
shots.narration_en: The differential gears let both sides turn at different speeds.
